qa_pair.question: According to the blog post template in assets/templates/blog_post.md, what phrase should NEVER be used to open a blog post? Provide the exact phrase mentioned.
Based on the README template in assets/templates/readme.md, what is the first section that should appear after the project title and badges? Answer with the exact section name.

According to the audience profiles defined in SKILL.md's Design Principles section, what is the maximum Flesch-Kincaid grade level for content targeting beginner developers? Answer with just the number.
Based on the audience calibration in SKILL.md, what is the jargon tolerance percentage for intermediate developers? Answer with just the number including the percent symbol.
According to the Voice Calibration table in SKILL.md, what voice style should be used when writing content about a Rust project? Provide the exact description from the table.
Based on the Voice Calibration table in SKILL.md, what voice style is recommended for Go projects? Provide the exact description.
What flag should be passed to analyze_codebase.py to enable full AST parsing and git narrative analysis? Answer with the exact flag including the dashes.
According to SKILL.md, what flag should be passed to analyze_readability.py to get pass/fail output suitable for CI/CD integration? Answer with the exact flag.
According to the Cognitive Load Management table in SKILL.md, what approach should be used when a project has more than 30 dependencies? Answer with the exact approach name.
Based on SKILL.md's Storytelling from Evidence section, what are the three sources that should be used to extract narrative? List the first source mentioned.
A blog post opens with "In this article, I will explain how we built our API." According to SKILL.md's Common Issues section, does this opening pass the hook quality check? Answer YES or NO.
Content targeting beginner developers has a Flesch-Kincaid grade level of 13.5. According to the Readability Thresholds table in SKILL.md, does this PASS or FAIL the Phase 6 gate?
A tutorial has 6 jargon terms in 100 words (6% jargon density) and targets intermediate developers. According to SKILL.md's audience thresholds (4% max for intermediate), does this PASS or FAIL?

A Twitter thread's first tweet reads: "Thread on caching strategies 1/8". According to the Twitter Thread Checklist in references/checklists.md, does this violate the "No Thread: or 1/ prefixes" rule? Answer YES or NO.

A blog post claims "performance improved by 50%" but provides no commit hash, file path, or benchmark source. According to Phase 4 Gate requirements in SKILL.md, can this content proceed to Phase 5? Answer YES or NO.
According to references/differentiation.md, what is the name of the governing test that asks whether a competitor could publish the piece unchanged? Answer with the exact test name.

A product launch post is fully evidence-grounded and passes readability, but swapping in a competitor's name leaves it reading identically. Per SKILL.md's Phase 6 gate, is delivery BLOCKED? Answer YES or NO.

In Phase 2 (Differentiation Discovery), the user declines the founder interview and you generate from code alone. What distinctiveness flag must be carried to the Phase 6 Quality Report? Answer with the exact two-word flag.
According to brand-voice.md, when a captured FOUNDER VOICE exists, is the tech-stack voice table the primary source or a fallback? Answer "primary" or "fallback".
Per brand-voice.md, should a project's spiky opinion be hedged because the project is version v0.x? Answer YES or NO.
According to the AI-tells blocklist in references/differentiation.md, the sentence shape "not just X - it's Y" should be flagged and rewritten. Should it be flagged? Answer YES or NO.

In the Distinctiveness Score (0-5) rubric in differentiation.md, a draft that leads with a feature list, has no defensible opinion, names no road not taken, and could be republished by a competitor scores how many points? Answer with just the number.
According to references/mcp-integration.md, if TweetClaw or OpenClaw is not configured during the handoff, should the skill fall back to copy-ready output? Answer YES or NO.
According to references/build-in-public.md, what document should be created FIRST before any build-in-public content to maintain narrative continuity? Answer with the exact template name.

According to the Milestone Matrix in references/build-in-public.md, when you achieve a "technical breakthrough" milestone, what is the PRIMARY content type recommended? Answer with the exact format name.
According to the Content Cascade Pattern in references/build-in-public.md, how many days after a major milestone should the comprehensive blog post be published? Answer with just the number.
